edits.new: 10. A REFUSED or UNDELIVERABLE result sets Unserved with that delivery status, writes the decision record under R-LIT-09, writes the ledger entry, publishes `rwb.comms.NoticeDelivered.v1` with the result, and asks rwb-case for the transfer of the case to its owner's queue with reason NOTICE_UNSERVED and for MSG-P6-008.
